name: Java Full Stack
certifications: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 21 Developer

beginner.summary: For developers who know basic programming and are new to building complete web applications with Java. Covers Java 21 language essentials, a Spring Boot REST API, PostgreSQL with Flyway and Spring Data JPA, validation and error handling, a React and TypeScript frontend with typed API calls, password-based login, backend and frontend tests, and running the stack in Docker Compose, ending with a working booking application.
prerequisites: Has written small programs in Java or another language and understands variables, loops and functions
Knows basic HTML and can use a terminal and Git commands such as clone, commit and push
Has a laptop with permission to install a JDK, Node.js, Docker and an IDE
outcomes: Build and run a Spring Boot REST API backed by PostgreSQL with versioned migrations
Build a React and TypeScript client that calls the API with typed requests, forms and server state
Add registration, login and protected routes with hashed passwords
Test both tiers and run the whole stack from a clean clone with Docker Compose

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built a basic Spring Boot and React application and now need production-quality practices. Covers layered design, JPA query tuning, concurrency control, JWT resource servers and refresh tokens, OpenAPI contracts, Redis caching, background jobs, S3 uploads, Testcontainers and Playwright tests, observability, hardened images, GitHub Actions pipelines and a cloud deployment on AWS with Terraform.
prerequisites: Has built a Spring Boot REST API with Spring Data JPA and a React client that calls it
Can write unit tests with JUnit 5 and run containers with Docker Compose
Has a GitHub account and an AWS account or sandbox with permission to create ECS, RDS, S3 and IAM resources
outcomes: Design secure, concurrent and efficient booking workflows across API, database and UI
Automate build, test, scan and publish steps for both tiers in a pipeline
Provision and deploy the platform on AWS with Terraform, ECS Fargate, RDS and CloudFront
Collect logs, metrics and traces and prove quality with unit, integration and browser tests

advanced.summary: For senior developers and tech leads who own the design and operation of full stack Java systems. Covers architecture decisions, Spring Modulith, OIDC with a backend-for-frontend, virtual threads, the outbox pattern with Kafka, zero-downtime schema changes, row-level security multi-tenancy, load and contract testing, Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD, OpenTelemetry and SLOs, security hardening, resilience, cost and disaster recovery, and incident troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has delivered a Java and React application to a cloud environment with CI/CD

Has access to a Kubernetes test cluster such as kind or a managed sandbox and to an AWS account
outcomes: Make and record architecture decisions and enforce them with automated checks
Operate a multi-tenant, observable platform against measured SLOs, capacity and recovery targets
Release changes safely with zero-downtime migrations, GitOps and metrics-gated canaries
Diagnose production incidents across browser, API and database with evidence
